mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park, but please note an elevated air quality index of 78.

The City of Verona has several updates today. The Finance Department has published the proposed 2027 budget online, and the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects, including a final plat for Ardent Glen, at their November 4th meeting.
We have a full calendar starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.

The Verona Police Department issued a report regarding an incident on Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired, though fortunately, no students were injured during the event.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:30 PM tonight.
